proposed_widenings.name: build_time_lineage_choice
proposed_widenings.justification: Gnomish Lineage requires choosing one of two distinct feature bundles (Forest/Rock) at character creation. SpeciesTraitMechanics = PassiveMechanics | ActivatedAbilityMechanics — neither family models a permanent build-time selection between bundles of different effect sets. No composite family exists for species traits (only class_feature has CompositeClassFeatureMechanics).
proposed_widenings.evidence: Choose one of the following options; whichever one you choose, Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for the spells you cast with this trait (choose the ability when you select the lineage)

proposed_widenings.name: SpellAccessMode: prepared_proficiency_bonus_per_long_rest
proposed_widenings.justification: Forest Gnome Speak with Animals grants: always prepared + PB free casts per LR + can use spell slots. Current prepared_once_per_long_rest covers exactly 1 free cast. There is no mode for 'prepared + UseCountCap.proficiency_bonus uses/LR'.
proposed_widenings.evidence: You can cast it without a spell slot a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest. You can also use any spell slots you have to cast the spell.

proposed_widenings.name: clockwork_device_creation
proposed_widenings.justification: Rock Gnome's clockwork device is a persistent interactive physical object (AC 5, 1 HP, Tiny) with: (1) a 10-minute Prestidigitation-cast creation cost, (2) a Bonus Action activation trigger openable by any creature via touch, (3) a 3-device concurrent pool cap, (4) per-device 8-hour duration. No existing atom or family covers interactive-object-with-foreign-trigger creation. create_object carries durability but not a foreign-triggerable bonus-action activation window or pool semantics.
proposed_widenings.evidence: you can spend 10 minutes casting Prestidigitation to create a Tiny clockwork device (AC 5, 1 HP)... whenever you or another creature takes a Bonus Action to activate it with a touch... You can have three such devices in existence at a time, and each falls apart 8 hours after its creation

proposed_widenings.name: spellcasting_ability_choice at lineage selection
proposed_widenings.justification: The trait requires the character to choose Int, Wis, or Cha as the spellcasting ability for all spells granted by this lineage. This is a build-time ability-selector that scopes to a specific trait's granted spells — no surface field exists on grant_spell_access or species_trait mechanics to model this.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for the spells you cast with this trait (choose the ability when you select the lineage)

notes: Gnomish Cunning (Advantage on Int/Wis/Cha saving throws) would encode cleanly as a passive modify_roll_advantage with saveAbilityFilter. The lineage-selection mechanic is the blocker: SpeciesTraitMechanics has no 'choose one of N bundles at character creation' pattern. Even if that were solved, Forest Gnome's 'PB uses per LR' spell access mode and Rock Gnome's clockwork device subgraph each require independent surface widenings. Three distinct widenings must all land before this unit can be encoded honestly. No content files authored.
